import { createDOMRoot } from "../../../../src/native_runtime_api.ts";

__nativeDefineComponent(".cache/structural-locality-protocol-v1/eligibility/runtime-gate-v2/native_controller.tsx#component:NativeCollectionMount", NativeCollectionMount, { propOnlySites: [] });

import { NativeCollectionBoard, makeRows } from "../native_collection.tsx";
import { NativeGenericBoard } from "../native_generic.tsx";
function NativeCollectionMount({ rows, life }) {
	return /* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeCollectionBoard, {
		rows,
		life
	});
}
function NativeGenericMount({ initialIds, life, registerIdsSetter }) {
	return /* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeGenericBoard, {
		initialIds,
		life,
		registerIdsSetter
	});
}
export function mountNative(arm, container, initialIds, life, record) {
	const root = createDOMRoot(container, {
		scheduleCommit: () => {},
		profileCounter: record
	});
	const rows = arm === "collection" ? makeRows(initialIds) : null;
	let setIds = null;
	const registerIdsSetter = (setter) => {
		if (setIds !== null) throw new Error("duplicate generic setter");
		setIds = setter;
		return () => {
			if (setIds === setter) setIds = null;
		};
	};
	try {
		if (rows) root.mount(/* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeCollectionMount, {
			rows,
			life
		}));
		else root.mount(/* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeGenericMount, {
			initialIds,
			life,
			registerIdsSetter
		}));
		root.flush();
	} catch (error) {
		try {
			root.dispose();
		} catch (disposeError) {
			throw new Error(`native mount failed: ${String(error)}; disposal failed: ${String(disposeError)}`);
		}
		throw error;
	}
	return {
		click(id) {
			const node = [...container.querySelectorAll("li[data-id]")].find((item) => item.dataset.id === id);
			if (!node) throw new Error(`missing click target ${id}`);
			node.click();
			root.flush();
		},
		edit(edit, next) {
			if (rows) {
				const operations = edit.kind === "move" ? [{
					type: "move",
					key: "row-0",
					beforeKey: null
				}] : edit.kind === "insert" ? [{
					type: "insert",
					key: "fresh-head",
					value: { id: "fresh-head" },
					beforeKey: "row-1"
				}] : edit.kind === "remove" ? [{
					type: "remove",
					key: "fresh-head"
				}] : [{
					type: "remove",
					key: "row-127"
				}, {
					type: "insert",
					key: "edge-new",
					value: { id: "edge-new" },
					beforeKey: "row-1"
				}];
				const applied = rows.apply(rows.version, operations);
				if (!applied.ok) throw new Error(`collection ${edit.kind} rejected: ${applied.reason}`);
			} else {
				if (!setIds) throw new Error("generic setter unregistered");
				setIds(next);
			}
			if (!root.flush()) throw new Error(`${arm} ${edit.kind}: no native commit`);
			return rows ? { ...rows.stats() } : {};
		},
		dispose() {
			root.dispose();
			const diagnostics = root.diagnostics();
			return {
				readerCount: rows?.stats().readerCount ?? null,
				ownerCount: diagnostics.ownerCount,
				setterRegistered: setIds !== null
			};
		}
	};
}
